title: Slipway authors
description: _data/authors.yml. Each key is an author id that a post names in `author` and an author page names in `author`.

avatar.description: A square image: a path on this site or an https link. Shown at 64 by 64 pixels.

bio.description: One or two sentences, shown in the author box.

links.description: Links shown under the bio, such as a website or a profile.

name.description: The name shown in bylines and author boxes.

url.description: A path on this site or an https link.
